'''Arts and culture'''
*[[AI boom]], [[Artificial intelligence in music]]
**The [[Australian Recording Industry Association]] bans wholly [[AI-generated music]] from appearing on [[ARIA Charts|its charts]] starting in September 2026. The ruling aims to distinguish fully AI-generated music and AI-assisted music, where the track is human-created but uses AI as a supporting tool. [https://www.dw.com/en/australias-music-chart-bars-fully-ai-generated-music/a-78491743 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**U.S. [[Central Intelligence Agency]] (CIA) [[Director of the Central Intelligence Agency|director]] [[John Ratcliffe]] visits [[Moscow]], [[Russia]], on an unscheduled military flight to meet with [[Foreign Intelligence Service (Russia)|Russian intelligence]] officials, marking the first known visit by a U.S. CIA director to Russia since 2021. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/26/kremlin-says-cia-head-met-russian-intelligence-officials-but-not-putin (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c87vg9x5d7do (BBC News)]
**[[The Wall Street Journal|''The Wall Street Journal'']] reports Ratcliffe's visit was to formally warn Russia against attacking [[NATO]] after [[military intelligence]] suggested Russia is preparing for a "limited assault" on a NATO member state. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/cia-director-john-ratcliffe-russia-visit-nato-kremlin-6342771 (AFP via CNA)] [https://www.wsj.com/politics/policy/cia-chiefs-surprise-moscow-trip-was-to-warn-russia-not-to-attack-nato-c2d997f3 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
